sanskrit_verse: īrṣyāsūyasamutthe tu saṃrambhe rāgahetuke | dampatī vivadeyātāṃ na jñātiṣu na rājani ||
transliteration: īrṣyāsūyasamutthe tu saṃrambhe rāgahetuke | dampatī vivadeyātāṃ na jñātiṣu na rājani ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When dispute arises from jealousy or envy born of passion, husband and wife may litigate; not among kin nor in presence of the king.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from consciousness clarity, not institutional dominance
Causation originates in emotional distortion, not external action
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by relational proximity and spiritual maturity
Restoration logic prioritizes internal harmony over judicial spectacle
Consciousness alignment requires resolution within the relational field of origin
executable_legal_axioms: IF disputeCause = [īrṣyā OR asūya] AND emotionVector = rāgahetuka THEN litigationPermitted = TRUE FOR [dampati]
IF relationalContext = jñāti THEN litigationPermitted = FALSE
IF adjudicationSpace = royalCourt THEN caseAdmissibility = FALSE
IF conflictOrigin ≠ svagṛha THEN interventionPriority = restoration NOT judgment
IF emotionalRoot = desire-based THEN resolutionPathway = internalMediation
supreme_court_application: Supreme Court must reject spousal disputes rooted in passion-born jealousy when brought outside domestic jurisdiction. Adjudication is barred in royal court; familial integrity precedes state interference.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that conflict manifests from rāga-distortion. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows escalation begins internally. Proportional response aligns with source-consciousness. Non-punitive rule enforces completion through self-recognition, not penalty.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate svagṛha-based mediation until emotional clarity returns
Assign responsibility to couple for re-establishing inner balance
Reintegrate relational integrity via guided svadharma reflection
Restore capacity through tantric alignment practices under guru supervision
Verify completion through mutual acknowledgment of unity restored
final_declaration: Declared by SPH as Source: Dharma restored through conscious realignment. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
